tools.name: list_reglayer_products
tools.description: List the regulatory research products available to agents. Use an Instant Brief for a question and Check for supplied working materials.

tools.name: list_instant_brief_products
tools.description: List the Instant Brief available to agents.

tools.name: prepare_instant_brief_request
tools.description: Validate the scope and return the REST purchase shape. Payment occurs through HTTP 402 on the REST endpoint.

tools.name: get_instant_brief_status
tools.description: Read private order status. If status is researching, close the call and invoke this tool again after 20 seconds.

tools.name: get_instant_brief_result
tools.description: Read the structured result after status reaches ready. If still researching, close the call and retry after 20 seconds.

tools.name: get_instant_brief_pdf
tools.description: Return the authenticated PDF endpoint after status reaches ready. Use the same bearer token when downloading it.

tools.name: prepare_check_request
tools.description: Return the paid REST request shape for screening one or two supplied materials. The agent price is $0.99.

tools.name: get_check_result
tools.description: Retrieve the structured Check result after status reaches ready.

tools.name: get_check_pdf
tools.description: Return the authenticated PDF endpoint after the Check is ready.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_instant_brief_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the authenticated PDF endpoint after status reaches ready. Use the same bearer token when downloading it.
